tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: Browse Axad's library of lessons and practice exams. With no lang, returns the languages Axad teaches. With lang, returns the sections and lessons at path in that language's tree (an empty path is its top). For a learner who wants something to study or works toward an exam.

tools.name: open_lesson
tools.description: Open a lesson and read where the learner is in it: a lesson of Axad's library (lesson), one the learner already has (material), or a new lesson made from a text they supply (text). Returns the current page's text or the first 40 sentences, and starter suggestions. It counts as one of the plan's acti

tools.name: list_lessons
tools.description: List the learner's lessons, the active ones first, then the closed ones, each with its language, page and progress. For a learner who wants to go on with something they studied.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one page of a lesson that has pages (a practice exam: one question and its text a page) and keep the learner's place there; for a lesson with no pages, read sentences from..to (at most 40). Returns the page text, or the numbered sentences.

tools.name: close_lesson
tools.description: Close a lesson the learner finished or set aside. Its place, chats and cards are kept, and it no longer counts against the plan's active lessons; opening it again by its material id reopens it. Returns the lesson's state and the active count.

tools.name: save_cards
tools.description: Save flash cards to the learner's bag: words, phrases or patterns they engaged with, at or just above their level. Takes 1 to 6 cards a call, each with its front, back and the sentence where it was met; a card already in the bag gets the new example. Returns the saved and skipped cards and the bag's

tools.name: due_cards
tools.description: List the learner's flash cards that are due for review now, the most overdue first, each with an example sentence. lang limits it to one language and limit (1 to 20, default 10) caps the number. Returns the cards and the total due.

tools.name: review_card
tools.description: Record how well the learner recalled a card: 1 forgot, 2 hard, 3 good, 4 easy. Schedules the card's next review (FSRS) and returns its due date.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Make a natural voice recording of a sentence in the language the learner learns. Returns a link to the audio and the start and end time of each word. It spends a little credit; each recording is kept, so the same sentence again is free.

tools.name: list_runbooks
tools.description: List Axad's learning paths (daily review, exam path, page by page, free-form chat), with the learner's place in each when signed in.

tools.name: start_runbook
tools.description: Start a learning path for the learner in a language, or return their place in it if they started it before. Returns the current step: what it asks, which tools and widgets it uses, and when it is done.

tools.name: next_step
tools.description: Read the learner's current step in a learning path they started, without moving it. Returns the step: what it asks, which tools and widgets it uses, and when it is done.

tools.name: record_step
tools.description: Record how the current step of a learning path went (done, skipped or struggled) with an optional note, and move the learner on. Returns the next step, or that the path is finished.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the learner's Axad account: their plan, its limits and what they use of them (cards in the bag, active lessons), and their credit spent and allowance.

tools.name: upgrade_link
tools.description: Return a link on axad.ai where the learner can pick a plan, add a card for more free use, or buy credit; want says which. Returns the url and a short text.

tools.name: redeem_gift
tools.description: Redeem a gift code the learner was given: its credit is added to their account at once. Returns the amount and the new credit.

tools.name: search_bag
tools.description: Search the learner's flash cards by words in the card's language or by a short meaning. Returns the matching cards, up to limit (default 10, at most 30); lang restricts the search to one language.

tools.name: find_images
tools.description: Search the shared image library for pictures that show a word, chunk, action or scene. query is a literal English description of the picture and lang the language of the concept. Returns up to 8 pictures, best fit first, each with a library id, title and concept.

tools.name: nominate_image
tools.description: Ask for a picture of a generic concept every learner shares: a concrete thing, action, place or everyday scene. Returns an existing library picture when one stands for the concept; otherwise checks the request against the library's rules and draws a new one, which fills in when ready (this spends cr

tools.name: show_gloss_chunks
tools.description: Displays how a span of the target language is built, for a learner who wants to see it: the text split into chunks, a literal gloss for each word, links between parts that stand apart, and a translation of the span.

tools.name: show_examples
tools.description: Displays 3 to 6 example sentences of a word, chunk or pattern at work, for a learner who wants to see it in use. Each has its translation and the target part marked, and may have a picture.

tools.name: show_alternatives
tools.description: Displays other ways to say the same thing, for a learner who wants to sound more natural or find a simpler form: the original and 2 to 5 alternatives, each tagged by kind, such as simpler or more formal.

tools.name: show_explain
tools.description: Displays a short explanation of one rule, exception or tip that explains what the learner met: a title, a few points and an optional small table.

tools.name: show_tips
tools.description: Displays tips that help a learner keep or use what they met: a tip for their exam, how people use it, or a memory trick, with an optional example sentence.

tools.name: show_contrast
tools.description: Displays two or three look-alike forms side by side, for a learner confused by the difference: one row per side with examples, and a test to tell them apart.

tools.name: show_pattern
tools.description: Displays a reusable sentence frame with slots, the fillers that fit each slot, and sentences built from it, for a learner who met a pattern they can use with other words.

tools.name: show_forms
tools.description: Displays the forms of one word as a table, for a learner who asks about them: verb conjugation, article or gender, plural, comparative or diminutive.

tools.name: show_correction
tools.description: Displays a check of the learner's own writing in a language they learn: what they wrote, the corrected text with the changes marked, a short reason for each fix, and a more natural version.

tools.name: show_quiz
tools.description: Displays one quick question for the learner to use what was just shown: choice, cloze, order or translate. The view checks the answer and shows the result with an explanation.

tools.name: show_shadow
tools.description: Plays short lines of the target language one by one and pauses after each for the learner to say it aloud, with each line's meaning.

tools.name: show_voice
tools.description: Plays a line or short dialogue for the learner to listen to, with the transcript hidden until shown or answered. It can limit replays like an exam's listening part, ask one question, or serve as repeat-after-me practice.

tools.name: show_picture
tools.description: Displays one library picture of a concrete word, chunk, action or scene, with the words it teaches, for a learner who remembers better with an image.

tools.name: show_dialogue
tools.description: Displays a role-play of a real situation, such as calling the doctor or asking the way, for a learner who wants to practise a conversation: 4 to 8 lines where the learner plays B and sees each B line on request.

tools.name: show_sentence_frame
tools.description: Displays one sentence split into the places its words take, for a learner who asks about word order: slots such as subject and verbs, the verb places marked, and a note on the rule.

tools.name: show_register
tools.description: Displays one message in a formal and an informal version, for a learner who asks how to say it politely or casually: the changed words are marked, with a note on who gets which.

tools.name: show_exam_task
tools.description: Displays one practice item in an exam's own format, for a learner who wants exam practice: a short text, a question, options and an optional timer. The view checks the pick and shows the explanation.

tools.name: show_scene
tools.description: Displays one library picture of a place or situation with its 3 to 6 key words beside it, for a learner who wants the vocabulary of a waiting room, a pharmacy or a kitchen.

tools.name: show_visual
tools.description: Displays a chart for a learner who needs to see how things relate: a verb grid across tenses, a time line, a sentence tree or a topic map.

tools.name: show_custom
tools.description: Displays a small layout built from blocks (say, text, table, list, image), for a learner who asks for something the other widgets do not show, such as a grid of prices or a mini dictionary of one theme.

tools.name: show_next
tools.description: Displays 1 to 6 one-click next steps under a reply: further asks the learner might make, and the next text to study. Clicking an item sends its message.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "show_custom" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Displays a small layout built from blocks (say, text, table, list, image), for a learner who asks for something the other widgets do not show, such as a grid of…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "show_custom" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
